newsitem.title: UK: Slovenia Eurobond seen at 300-500 mln DEM -bankers.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia Eurobond seen at 300-500 mln DEM -bankers.

text.p: Slovenia's forthcoming debut in the mark Eurobond market is expected to raise between 300 and 500 million marks, syndicate managers said on Wednesday.
Slovenia said the timing, size and maturity of the transaction would be announced shortly before its launch.
Credit Suisse First Boston and Dresdner Kleinwort Benson, appointed to underwrite the deal, were not immediately available to comment.
But bankers elsewhere said they expected the launch as soon as late May or early June, after investor presentations in mid-May.
Bankers said they expected Slovenia to issue seven- or 10-year bonds.
"A 10-year maturity might be too long a term from an investor point of view," said one banker.

He said Slovenia, rated A3 by Moody's Investors Service and A by Standand and Poor's Corp, would have to pay a spread of Libor plus 25 basis points on a seven-year bond and Libor plus 35 b.p. on a 10-year bond.
Last July, Slovenia launched a debut Eurobond issue via J.P. Morgan.

The $325 million five-year deal was priced to yield 58 basis points over U.S. Treasury notes, at the time the tightest spread for any Eurobond out of Eastern Europe. -- Debra Sherman, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7658
